findings.title: Billing metrics overflow the shared hero column on desktop
findings.detail: The migrated header places headingArea, which contains metricBand, in the second column of .mg-hero. The shared primitive caps that column at 330px, while AdminBillingPage.module.css keeps metricBand at min-width: 520px above the 1180px media query. Consequently the four-card metric band cannot fit its assigned hero column on ordinary desktop widths and will overflow or collide with the hero boundary. This is a responsive regression and an invalid semantic/layout fit for the selected shared primitive.
